title: Explorers of Ixalan: card flavor text

entities.name: Kaalia of the Vast
entities.description: A speaker who prefers loyalty out of respect rather than magic, but does what she must.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: A figure in The History of Kamigawa who grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The world whose history is recorded in The History of Kamigawa.

entities.name: The History of Kamigawa
entities.description: An in-world written history that recounts Konda's growing suspicion.

entities.name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
entities.description: The spymaster of Trest, who remarks that soaring is wasted on the winged.

entities.name: Trest
entities.description: The place Edric serves as spymaster.

entities.name: General Tazri
entities.description: An allied commander who urges letting the vampires join the war effort.

entities.name: Xathi the Infallible
entities.description: A speaker of the Silumgar who says every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of their dragonlord.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A group whose blades carry the blessing of their dragonlord.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: One who fancies himself king of the undercity, derided as merely king of rot.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A speaker who holds that no emergency is too dire to be dealt with elegantly.

entities.name: Squib
entities.description: Someone addressed in a moment of mutiny with "You too, Squib?"

entities.name: Vessifrus
entities.description: A flamekin demagogue who says souls burn more brightly together than apart.

entities.name: Ruhan of the Fomori
entities.description: A speaker of the Fomori who refers to himself in the third person.

entities.name: Fomori
entities.description: The people Ruhan belongs to.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region with only one route into Stensia.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region reachable from Kessig by only one route.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: The home of the Leina Tower warriors.

entities.name: Leina Tower
entities.description: A warrior group of Setessa whose members must fear not death, only failure.

entities.name: Harvest Moon
entities.description: The moon under which reapers cut the grains.

entities.name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
entities.description: A ghost chieftain who calls savagery the birthright of every creature that draws breath.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A group with an army of soldiers and respected mage-priests.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A millennia-old vampire (a planeswalker) who is fatal to those who cross his path.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: An empire long associated with dinosaurs, whose people worship the sun in three aspects.

events.summary: According to The History of Kamigawa, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated.
events.quote: Over time, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands.

events.summary: General Tazri calls for the vampires to be allowed to join the allies in the war.
events.quote: Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades.

relations.quote: Every Silumgar blade carries the blessing of our dragonlord.
To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

relations.note: Subject of The History of Kamigawa
